scripts.check: tsc -b && eslint . --max-warnings 0 && prettier --check . && vitest run --passWithNoTests && supabase test db && npm run db:types:check
scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --local > src/db.types.ts.tmp && mv src/db.types.ts.tmp src/db.types.ts
scripts.db:types:check: f=$(mktemp) && supabase gen types typescript --local > $f && (diff -q $f src/db.types.ts > /dev/null || (echo 'src/db.types.ts is out of date: run npm run db:types' && exit 1))
